newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-S&P rates NSW T-Corp 20 bln yen samurai AA.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-S&P rates NSW T-Corp 20 bln yen samurai AA.

text.p: Ratings agency Standard and Poor's Corp said on Monday it had assigned its AA rating to the New South Wales Treasury Corporation's (T-Corp) 20 billion yen dual currency samurai bonds maturing October 7, 1999.
The ratings reflected that of the guarantor, the state of New South Wales, S&P said. T-Corp is the central borrowing agency for the New South Wales public sector.
"The rating of these bonds is constrained by the AA foreign currency sovereign rating of the Commonwealth of Australia," S&P said, adding the foreign currency outlook is positive.
